# Therapy Central

> > Therapy Central provides expert mental health counselling and psychotherapy in London and online, delivered by HCPC/UKCP/BACP qualified therapists specializing in CBT and trauma treatment.

Therapy Central is a London-based therapy practice offering both in-person and online counselling services across a wide range of mental health conditions. The practice emphasizes evidence-based treatments, particularly Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), and maintains accreditation with major UK professional bodies.

## Key Topics

- CBT (Cognitive Behavioural Therapy)
- London therapy services
- Online therapy and counselling
- Anxiety disorders (GAD, social anxiety, panic)
- Depression counselling
- OCD and ERP treatment
- PTSD and trauma therapy
- HCPC/UKCP/BACP qualified therapists
- Relationship counselling
- Mental health treatment
- Bipolar disorder therapy
- Health anxiety
- Eating disorders
- Addictions therapy
- Bereavement counselling

- [Therapy Central Home](https://therapy-central.com): Therapy Central homepage: expert therapy in London & online with HCPC/UKCP/BACP qualified therapists

## Anxiety & Panic Disorders

- [Anxiety Therapy in London & Online](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/anxiety-therapy-london): Anxiety therapy with CBT specialists for generalized anxiety disorder and related conditions
- [GAD Therapy in London & Online](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/gad-therapy-in-london): Generalized Anxiety Disorder therapy with qualified CBT therapists in London & online
- [Panic Attack Treatment in London & Online](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/panic-attack-treatment-london): Panic attack and panic disorder treatment using proven CBT methods in London & online
- [Social Anxiety Therapy London](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/social-anxiety-disorder-treatment-london): Social anxiety and phobia therapy from expert CBT specialists with 900+ treated clients

## Mood & Trauma Disorders

- [Depression Counselling in London & Online](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/depression-counselling): Depression counselling service in London & online with accredited CBT therapists
- [Bipolar Disorder Treatment in London & Online](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/bipolar-disorder): Bipolar disorder and manic depression treatment with qualified CBT therapists
- [PTSD Therapy London](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/ptsd-trauma-therapy-london): PTSD and trauma therapy from specialist therapists using CBT and EMDR treatment
- [Bereavement Counselling in London & Online](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/bereavement-counselling): Bereavement and grief support counselling from qualified therapists in London & online

## Obsessive-Compulsive & Specific Disorders

- [OCD Therapy London](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/ocd-therapy-london): OCD therapy from specialist CBT & ERP therapists with proven successful treatment results
- [Health Anxiety Therapy in London & Online](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/health-anxiety-hypochondria): Health anxiety and hypochondria treatment with qualified CBT therapists in London
- [Phobia Therapy in London and Online](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/phobia): Phobia and agoraphobia therapy with qualified therapists using CBT treatment methods

## Behavioral & Emotional Health

- [Relationship Counselling in London](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/relationship-counselling-london-online): Relationship and couples counselling for communication problems and relationship issues
- [Anger Management Counselling in London & Online](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/anger-management-london): Anger management counselling with qualified CBT therapists in London & online
- [Low Self-Esteem Therapy in London & Online](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/low-self-esteem): Low self-esteem and confidence building counselling with CBT treatment in London
- [Assertiveness Training in London and Online](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/assertiveness-training): Assertiveness training for communication skills and relationship success in London

## Specialized Treatment Areas

- [Addictions Therapy in London & Online](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/addictions-therapy-london): Addictions therapy for substance abuse and behavioral addictions with CBT treatment
- [Eating Disorder Therapy in London & Online](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/eating-disorder-therapy): Eating disorder therapy including anorexia nervosa treatment with qualified therapists
- [Personality Disorders Therapy](https://therapy-central.com/what-we-do/personality-disorder): Personality disorder therapy including borderline personality disorder treatment
